title: Design around worship, community and reality.
summary: Build a community brief, test sites and adaptive reuse, orient to qibla, plan prayer capacity, wudu, accessibility, interiors, parking, landscape and phased growth.

title: Make the approval path legible.
summary: Select the project jurisdiction, organize likely approvals and authority sources, assign documents and comments, and preserve a clear record from feasibility to occupancy.

title: Connect every contribution to a real project need.
summary: Turn an abstract fundraising target into transparent components, restricted purposes, cash-flow needs, project progress and long-term operating sustainability.

title: Find what the mosque needs, compare it, then bind it to the project.
summary: Discover products, local suppliers, specialist vendors and professionals; compare technical fit, source evidence, landed cost, lead time, samples, RFQs and alternatives.

title: Keep the site connected to the decisions that created it.
summary: Coordinate schedule, packages, RFIs, submittals, evidence, inspections, change orders, progress and handover without losing the institutional history in chats and inboxes.

title: Opening day is the beginning of the building lifecycle.
summary: Turn handover into an asset register, preventive maintenance, work orders, warranties, recurring operations and post-occupancy learning.
